[{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Hi Linda, how have you been feeling lately?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Hey. Honestly, it's been a tough week. Losing Max still feels so raw."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds like Max meant a lot to you."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"He really did. Max was more than just a pet; he was part of the family."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I can imagine it's like a part of your daily life is missing now. How are you coping?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It helps that David moved in. It's comforting not to be alone in the apartment."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's good to hear. Like I'm burdening him with my grief."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's understandable to feel that way, but remember, it's okay to lean on someone you trust."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, he keeps saying he wants to be there for me, but I'm still struggling to accept help."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That can definitely be challenging. What do you think is making it hard to accept his support?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I guess I've always been independent. Relying on someone else feels foreign to me."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That makes sense. Sometimes accepting support is part of growing together. It can be a way to strengthen your bond."}]

You're right, and I do appreciate him being here. It's a learning process for both of us.
